user.title: Add a cycle tracker
user.description: One tracker per person. It's private to its owner until they choose to share it from the card.

data.name: Name
data.owner: Whose tracker is this? (their Home Assistant user)

data_description.cycle_length: Only used until a few cycles have been logged or imported.
data_description.period_length: Only used until a few periods have been logged or imported.

abort.already_configured: That person already has a tracker.

init.title: Cycle settings
init.description: Who can see this tracker is up to its owner, from the settings in the card. An admin can switch on the owner's own notifications here. They only go to the owner's phones, so nobody else sees anything.

data.notify_phase: Cycle notifications to the owner's phones
data.notify_checkin: Daily 'How do you feel today?' reminder to the owner's phones

data_description.luteal_length: Days from ovulation to the next period. 14 is typical; only change this if you know yours.
data_description.notify_phase: A notification when their phase changes, like the fertile window starting or a period being due. Only ever sent to the owner's own phones (not Macs), including ones they sign in on later.
data_description.notify_checkin: Skipped on days something has already been logged. Also only sent to the owner's own phones.
data_description.open_path: Where tapping the reminder goes, for example /dashboard-cycle/cycle. It opens on the Track tab.
